title: Lumos signed voucher / bootstrap token
$comment: Signed voucher token, carried by message class 0x42 VOUCHER_TOKEN and by QR bootstrap. Single-use: the nonce is checked against VOUCHER_NONCE_CACHE and a repeat is rejected with ERR_VOUCHER_NONCE_REPLAY. The token carries NO personal data - not an alias, not a profile reference, not a device identifier - because it may be displayed, photographed and shared in a venue (SRS-NFR-PRI).
x-size-bound: A token embedded in a QR bootstrap must fit transport.QR_BOOTSTRAP_MAX_BYTES once canonically encoded and signed.

nonce.$comment: 128-bit random, single use. Replay is detected against VOUCHER_NONCE_CACHE (count and days from the register).

valid_until.$comment: Expiry is evaluated against a monotonic-clock-corrected time with CLOCK_SKEW_TOLERANCE_SEC applied. An expired token yields ERR_CONFIG_EXPIRED.

revocable.$comment: When true the client consults the revocation set before honouring; a revoked token yields ERR_VOUCHER_REVOKED.
